Removed the Friday-only 15:00 cutoff and its date-conversion logic. All days now allow non-conflicting meetings within 09:00–17:00, retaining 15-minute start intervals and existing function signatures.

Checks passed for event conflicts, boundary times, fully booked days, and Friday availability.
